name: touchdown
description: Correct GitHub deployment records — recorder, not a deployer.

scripts.package: ncc build src/index.ts -o dist --source-map --license licenses.txt && node scripts/emit-dist-package.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run build && oxlint src __tests__ && oxfmt --check src __tests__
scripts.check:dist: npm run package && git diff --ignore-space-at-eol --exit-code dist/
